churches.assessment: Bel Air Church (formerly Bel Air Presbyterian Church) is the historic Presbyterian congregation on Mulholland Drive in Los Angeles, founded 1956. Ronald and Nancy Reagan joined as official members after leaving the White House in 1989 and worshiped there until their deaths. Donn D. Moomaw, the long-time former senior pastor, gave the invocation at President Reagan's first inauguration in 1981 and presided at his funeral. Bel Air did not depart to ECO during the 2012-2015 PCUSA exodus when over 100,000 conservative PCUSA members left for ECO: A Covenant Order of Evangelical Presbyterians — Bel Air stayed PCUSA, which institutionally has departed from biblical authority on sexual ethics and ordains women as elders and pastors at every level. Current senior pastor is Rev. Dr. Drew Sams. Per MOOP rubric this is RED at the denominational level; included for situational awareness about Ronald Reagan's home church.
churches.denomination_detail: PCUSA — stayed with the denomination through the 2012-2015 ECO departure wave; rebranded "Bel Air Church" but remains PCUSA.
churches.gender_detail: PCUSA permits women at all levels of ordination; egalitarian.

Live-fetched https://www.belair.org/ + Wikipedia + PCUSA congregation directory + ECO Presbyterian about page on 2026-05-16 — confirmed PCUSA affiliation (not ECO) + 16221 Mulholland Dr + founded 1956 + Reagans joined 1989 + Donn D. Moomaw gave 1981 inaugural invocation + Rev. Dr. Drew Sams current senior pastor.

score_notes.christology: Evangelical Friends tradition affirms Trinitarian orthodoxy and Christ's deity (distinct from liberal FGC/FUM unprogrammed branches).
score_notes.scripture: Evangelical Friends affirm biblical authority and inerrancy in the Richmond Declaration tradition.

score_notes.mission: Friends Southwest church-planting + global missions tradition (e.g., Bolivia, Peru, Kenya through EFM).

churches.assessment: East Whittier Friends Church is the lifelong home meeting of Richard Milhous Nixon — the 37th President was raised here from age 9, played piano in Sunday school, taught Sunday school as a young attorney, and remained a member until his death in 1994. The congregation is part of Friends Southwest, the evangelical/programmed branch of Quakerism — distinct from the liberal unprogrammed Friends General Conference (FGC) and Friends United Meeting (FUM) which have moved toward LGBT affirmation. Evangelical Friends affirm Trinitarian orthodoxy, biblical authority, and grace-through-faith soteriology in the Richmond Declaration tradition. Worship is bilingual (English/Spanish) and programmed — looking more like a contemporary evangelical service than the silent meetings stereotypically associated with Quakers. Female pastoral leadership is present (Pastora Delia Madrid) — consistent with Quakerism's 17th-century affirmation of women in ministry, but yellow on MOOP's rubric. Solid green at the denominational and theological core; historic Americana.
churches.gender_detail: Female pastor (Pastora Delia Madrid); Quaker tradition affirms women in ministry from inception (1650s).

review_flag.reason: Verified live 2026-05-16; Friends Southwest affiliation per fsw.church.

churches.enrichment_notes: Live-fetched 2026-05-16: eastwhittierfriends.org confirms 15911 E Whittier Blvd, Sunday 9:30 bilingual worship, affiliated with Friends Southwest (programmed evangelical Quakers — distinct from liberal FGC/FUM branches). Friends Journal + QuakerSpeak document Nixon's lifelong membership from age 9 until death 1994; he taught Sunday school and played piano. Pastor Eugene Coffin (deceased) was Nixon's pastor here and conducted White House services during Nixon presidency.

churches.denomination: United Reformed Churches in North America

score_notes.christology: Affirms Nicene orthodoxy via Belgic Confession.
score_notes.scripture: Reformed doctrine of Scripture — inerrant, sufficient, final authority.

churches.assessment: Escondido URC is a flagship URCNA congregation in North San Diego County, pastored by Rev. Chris Gordon (host of Abounding Grace Radio and a widely recognized voice in confessional Reformed circles). The church holds strictly to the Three Forms of Unity (Belgic Confession, Heidelberg Catechism, Canons of Dort), preaches the Heidelberg Catechism in a second service, and maintains male-only officers. This is textbook confessional Continental Reformed practice — no women in office, no cultural drift, serious catechetical formation for children and adults.

score_notes.christology: Unequivocally orthodox. Christ alone, Trinity affirmed, MacArthur legacy.
score_notes.scripture: Inerrancy champion — this church is known globally for holding Scripture as supreme authority.
score_notes.gender: GREEN — strong complementarian/patriarchal vision. Male elders only. MacArthur publicly defended male-only pastoral leadership.
score_notes.leadership: Male elders, plural elder model, The Master's Seminary accountability.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformed — sovereign grace, faith alone, Lordship salvation.
score_notes.cultural: Counter-cultural. Defied COVID lockdowns. Anti-woke. Strong on biblical ethics.
score_notes.preaching: Gold standard of verse-by-verse expository preaching.
score_notes.mission: Grace to You global ministry, The Master's Seminary, church planting.
score_notes.denominational: Non-denominational; The Master's Seminary confirmed on homepage as part of 'Family of Ministries' — provides theological accountability. John MacArthur prominent in leadership section.

churches.assessment: Grace Community Church, Sun Valley CA — the flagship church of the late John MacArthur (died July 14, 2025, after 56 years of ministry). Nathan Busenitz serving as Staff Pastor (interim leadership) and Mark Zhakevich handling administrative operations (announced August 28, 2025). Three Sunday services. Non-denominational with strong Reformed Baptist theology. Known worldwide for expository preaching. The Master's Seminary on campus. Theologically one of the most well-known conservative evangelical churches in America.

churches.assessment: Harvest Christian Fellowship under Greg Laurie is one of the great evangelistic churches in America. Laurie has been faithfully preaching verse-by-verse for over 50 years and his Harvest Crusades have brought millions to hear the gospel. The 'Jesus Revolution' film captured his testimony and the broader Jesus Movement story. Doctrinally sound, evangelistically active, and culturally conservative. GREEN — Laurie's half-century of faithful ministry speaks for itself. Minor note: Harvest left the Calvary Chapel Association in 2012, which removed some accountability structure.

churches.assessment: Saddleback Church is one of the most influential churches in American history through Rick Warren's 'Purpose Driven' model. churches.assessment: The View Church (Menifee, CA) is a fast-growing African-American SBC congregation under lead pastor Gregory Perkins, who serves as president of the National African American Fellowship of the SBC. The current staff page lists Dr. Regina Bennett as 'Pastor of Discipleship' and Minister Annsy Vanoukia as 'Pastor of Worship, Arts & Guest Relations' — both women holding pastor titles in tension with BF&M 2000 Article VI ('the office of pastor is limited to men as qualified by Scripture'). churches.assessment: Third Baptist Church of San Francisco is the oldest African-American Baptist congregation west of the Rockies (founded 1852). For nearly half a century — 1976 to 2025 — it was pastored by Rev. Amos C. Brown, a civil-rights leader and close advisor to Kamala Harris. Brown gave the convention prayer at the 2024 DNC. Harris has been a member for more than 20 years and worked for Brown's campaign for San Francisco supervisor in 2000; he was reportedly among the first people she called when Joe Biden suspended his 2024 campaign and she became the presumptive Democratic nominee. Rev. Devon Jerome Crawford succeeded Brown on July 1, 2025. Theologically the congregation operates in the progressive Black social-gospel tradition with heavy reparations and racial-justice framing; ABC-USA affiliation places it on the affirming end of Baptist polity. Per MOOP rubric this is RED; included for situational awareness about the home church of a recent Democratic nominee for President.
churches.denomination_detail: American Baptist Churches USA (ABC-USA) + National Baptist Convention USA dual affiliation; historic Black Baptist congregation founded 1852.
churches.gender_detail: Egalitarian — ABC-USA permits women pastors and elders.
churches.enrichment_notes: Live-fetched Wikipedia + Sojourners + Christian Post + Baptist Standard + Christian Century coverage on 2026-05-16 — confirmed Rev. Devon Jerome Crawford as senior pastor since 2025-07-01 (succeeded Rev. Amos C. Brown 1976-2025) + 1399 McAllister St + founded 1852 + Kamala Harris longtime member. Note: previous MOOP directory entry for "third-baptist-louisville" had broken URL pointing to thirdbaptist.org (this San Francisco congregation) — separate church; Louisville is thirdavenue.org.

churches.assessment: Trinity Southern Baptist Church is a Central Valley SBC anchor congregation in Fresno. Senior Pastor Dr. Zach Edwards joined in November 2019 and serves alongside Executive Pastor Don Sullivan and Pastor of Caring Jim Winchester (68+ years of ministry experience). The church is officially listed in the churches.sbc.net SBC Find-A-Church directory and is part of the California Southern Baptist Convention. For a man in Fresno or the Central Valley seeking an established SBC congregation with multi-generational pastoral depth, Trinity is a credible choice. Verify current ministry health and discipleship culture in person.

churches.assessment: Trinity URC Visalia is a confessional Continental Reformed congregation in California's Central Valley, pastored by Rev. Michael G. Brown — a recognized Reformed scholar (editor/contributor on works including 'Christ and the Condition' and Reformation Heritage Books projects). Holds strictly to the Three Forms of Unity (Belgic Confession, Heidelberg Catechism, Canons of Dort). Two-service Lord's Day pattern with afternoon catechism preaching. Male-only officers, confessional subscription, no cultural drift. A serious option for confessional Reformed believers in the Fresno/Visalia corridor where confessional Reformed options are sparse.
